categories.main_business_segments: Ganzhou Tengyuan Cobalt New Material Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of cobalt, copper, nickel, lithium, and battery material precursors. The company focuses on new energy metal resource development and utilization, serving as a leading global producer of cobalt, copper, and battery precursor products. It also extends into downstream products like ternary precursors and cobalt oxides for lithium batteries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in cobalt wet-process metallurgy technology and has developed advanced recycling technologies for diverse cobalt resources and spent lithium batteries. It employs wet leaching, solvent extraction, and electro-winning processes, with proprietary improvements in impurity removal and metal recovery. The company integrates production lines for cobalt, nickel, lithium, and copper, optimizing cost and efficiency through continuous R&D and process innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the new energy vehicle sector, 3C consumer electronics, defense, and industrial applications. The company supplies battery material producers, automotive manufacturers, and chemical industries globally. Its products are critical for lithium-ion battery cathodes, high-temperature alloys, magnetic materials, and catalysts.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span China, with headquarters and main production in Ganzhou, Jiangxi Province, and overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Zimbabwe. The company sources raw materials globally, especially from Congo's copper-cobalt belt, and sells products domestically and internationally, with over 50% of revenue from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ganzhou Tengyuan operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on refining and processing of cobalt, copper, nickel, and lithium raw materials into battery-grade chemicals and metals. It also extends upstream by securing mining rights and downstream by producing battery precursors and recycling spent batteries, aiming to build a closed-loop supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes expanding resource control, enhancing recycling technologies, and developing new battery materials such as cobalt oxides and ternary precursors. It invests in R&D collaborations with universities and has established a research institute to innovate in wet-process metallurgy, impurity removal, and battery waste recycling. Future R&D focuses include low-cost wet metallurgy for black powder recycling and new precursor synthesis.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of refined cobalt, copper, nickel, lithium products, and battery material precursors. The company operates a direct sales model, pricing products based on international metal market benchmarks such as LME and Shanghai Metals Market quotations. It also earns government subsidies and engages in hedging activities to manage commodity price risks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ganzhou Tengyuan is positioned as a leading domestic cobalt salt producer and a significant global player in cobalt and battery precursor materials. It competes with other major cobalt refiners and battery material suppliers, leveraging its integrated resource base, advanced metallurgy technology, and strategic overseas mining investments to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 6.54 billion, an 18% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders rising by over 81% to RMB 685 million. The company has shown strong growth in nickel and lithium product sales, with significant capacity expansions underway. Total assets reached RMB 10.7 billion, reflecting steady growth and ongoing capital investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ganzhou Tengyuan emphasizes its technological leadership in cobalt wet-process metallurgy and comprehensive recycling capabilities, enabling efficient, low-cost production from diverse raw materials including low-grade ores and battery waste. Its integrated supply chain from resource acquisition to downstream battery precursor production offers customers stable, high-quality materials tailored for the rapidly growing new energy and electronics markets.
